provenance.capture: wording case written for this tree from V1's pattern list; no frame of a permission prompt has been captured, because this machine's agents run with permissions already granted. It exists so that no pattern ships without a case, and it asserts the normalized form and nothing more
provenance.ported: the wording only, normalized. The V1 frame it came from was itself a one-line sanitized text, not a screen
provenance.identical: the wording appears in the V1 and V2 pattern lists
provenance.note: Retire trigger: the first recorded frame of a real permission prompt. It either proves this wording, and this file is replaced by the recording, or it contradicts it, and the pattern goes with the file
